title: Sakamoto San from Nichijou nametag
description: Turns cats into Sakamoto San from Nichijou when named "Sakamoto"
body:
This texture pack adds a new look for cats when renamed "Sakamoto".

Note : You will need [Optifine](https://optifine.net/downloads) or [Entity Texture Features](https://modrinth.com/mod/entitytexturefeatures) for this texture pack to work.
